packageRules.description: Auto-merge for digest and patch bumps on GitHub Actions (per ADR-039 — SHA pinning is the integrity primitive; patch within a pinned major is the lowest-risk update class).
Manual review required for major version bumps. Major bumps can include breaking config changes that the per-PR review must catch before merge.

Stateful tier images — manual review only (per ADR-038 anti-stomp). The aegis-statefulset application image and embedded LevelDB updates can affect the on-disk format; review against the change log every time.
Helm charts — pin to OCI digest, not version (per ADR-039). Renovate's helmv3 manager rewrites tag references to sha256 digests on first encounter.
Container images in Dockerfiles and Helm values — same digest pinning posture as Helm charts.
Terraform providers — pin to specific versions, no auto-merge. Provider upgrades can rewrite state schema; reviewer checks the upgrade guide before merging.

regexManagers.description: Pin Terraform module SHA references (per ADR-039). Matches `source = "git::...?ref=<40-char-sha>"` in .tf files.
